how_it_works: Lazily loads a process-wide Laya agent

purpose: Call sites use this module for typed local decisions instead of repeating model loading and concurrency handling. It remembers failed loads, clips state inputs, optionally logs bounded decisions, and provides shared mode parsing and counters.
summary: Loads one shared Laya decision model and exposes serialized, fail-open prediction and gate utility helpers.

side_effects: imports and loads the Laya checkpoint
symbols.summary: Returns or lazily loads the process-wide Laya agent with failed-load cooldown.
Splits text into a bounded number of fixed-size chunks.
Fits text to a character budget while keeping its head, tail, or both.
Appends a bounded prediction record to the configured decision log.
Runs one locked Laya prediction and returns None on any failure.
Parses a gate mode and safely maps unknown values to off.
Best-effort increments a thirty-day memory-bus counter.
Best-effort reads a memory-bus counter and returns zero on failure.

unknowns: The actual Laya checkpoint implementation is external to this module.
